notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Happily_Ever_After/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Not_a_Hero/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172940/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Threads_of_Destiny/

notes.title: Update v. 0.9 is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/463d541f485756cf997a6aa41c5ab0e67d00ca09.jpg[/img]
Greetings
New update is finally here!

[h3][b]Optimization and performance improvements[/b][/h3]
The technical part of the game has been thoroughly reworked, and it now runs [b]faster and smoother[/b]. The Steam Deck tests showed a significant improvement: whereas version 0.8.5.10 overheated the device and caused FPS drops, version 0.9 maintains frame rate and offers steady gameplay.

[h3][b]New quests, characters and dialogs[/b][/h3]
While we were working on the second chapter, the first chapter received [b]new quests, new characters, and expanded dialog[/b]. They will help you dive deeper into the story and lead you towards a way out of the [b]Misty Valley[/b].

[h3][b]the Magic System Improvements[/b][/h3]
We have added the ability to assign new spells that the hero can use in combination with melee weapons. Additionally, we have introduced several new spells that you can learn as you progress through the story. More spells will be added in the future.

[h3][b]Evolution of the combat system[/b][/h3]
Each weapon has been enhanced with [b]new techniques[/b], making battles [b]more dynamic and entertaining[/b]. Additionally, now the variety of attacks directly affects effectiveness: the more diverse your blows, the faster they become, and the more damage they deal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/3625916cb4c4e253f7430e4c9934224b2b7598fa.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/697c8633225cf8224f1f2897987abf57a85f8d75.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/f770f5907d2d822fd30a542fa5fc7fe39237d37a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Improved controls[/b][/h3]
The controls have been made more responsive based on your feedback. As a result, our protagonist now instantly responds to commands, [b]moves smoothly[/b], and interacts with the environment[b] more predictably[/b].

[h3][b]Fixes and improvements[/b][/h3]
There have been a lot of bugs fixed, including critical ones that could prevent players from completing the game. We encourage you to report bugs in [url=https://discord.gg/AF5U7yyhfb]Discord[/url] or discussions. Try loading an earlier save if you encounter a problem. Only two people are working on the game, so we appreciate your patience and support!

[h3][b]A Glimpse of the Future: The Middle Lot[/b][/h3]
Along with this update, we've been working on Chapter 2, and now we're ready to reveal the [b]The Middle Lot[/b], the mysterious region where the final part of the story will unfold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/1a344112ccbe9d9a0625898b5e8dd2580fb79c57.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/521b1b4dc4e3176019135147648ceecbcb0ea83b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/a170373a765bc8119ffe07336805c2fba1f535d6.jpg[/img]


Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Upcoming updates and fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824743/13aee211a65f472ae16540155734561ae3ca6585.jpg[/img]
Dear players!

We have carefully reviewed your feedback and announce that upcoming updates will include:
[list]
[*] Performance improvement.
[*] Detailed graphics settings, including disabling motion blur, antialiasing and others.
[*] Key remapping settings.
[*] Font size settings.
[*] Correction of the problem of kicking on the gamepad.
[/list]
This is what we're focusing on right now. Some of these improvements will be available at the end of this week.

Big thanks for support to all!
Stay tuned!
